chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from a number of our companions from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ibn Mahbub from Ali ibn Ri'ab from Mis'mam from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): Regarding

the man who performs an Umrah al-Mufradah, then tawaf around the House with the obligatory tawaf, then has intercourse with his wife before sa'i between Safa and Marwah. He (peace be upon him) said: 'He has invalidated his Umrah, and upon him is a Hadi (sacrificial animal), and he must remain in Mecca in the state of Ihram until the month in which he performed Umrah passes, then he goes out to the time that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) appointed for the people of their lands, and he enters Ihram from there and performs Umrah.'

key_terms.عُمْرَةٌ مُفْرَدَةٌ: Umrah al-Mufradah (Umrah performed independently, not combined with Hajj)
key_terms.يَغْشَى أَهْلَهُ: He has intercourse with his wife
key_terms.يُقِيمَ مُحِلًّا: Remains in the state of Ihram

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man has intercourse with his wife before sa'i during Umrah al-Mufradah?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the specific penalty for a pilgrim performing Umrah al-Mufradah who engages in sexual intercourse before completing the Sa'i between Safa and Marwah. The ruling invalidates the current Umrah, requiring a sacrificial animal (Hadi) and a period of remaining in Mecca in Ihram until the lunar month concludes, after which he must exit and perform a new Umrah from the Miqat. This highlights the distinct legal consequences of breaking the state of Ihram during the specific sequence of rituals in the Mufradah form.
